examples.title: Council tax rise approved as opposition warns of household squeeze
examples.body_text: Surrey County Council approved a 4.99% council tax increase on Tuesday, with the Conservative administration arguing the rise was unavoidable after years of rising social care demand. The Liberal Democrat opposition warned the increase would squeeze household budgets across Woking at the worst possible moment. Council leader Tim Oliver said the alternative was cutting services that residents rely on every day. Opposition finance spokesman Will Forster said families in Woking would pay the price for a decade of poor financial management at County Hall.
